Marathon Partners Equity Management Holding In Hd Supply Hldgs (HDS) Was Has Increased; Oak Ridge Investments Has Lowered Its Fidelity National Information (FIS) Stake as Stock Price Rose
May 29, 2018 - By Henry Gaston
Mario Cibelli increased its stake in Hd Supply Hldgs Inc (HDS) by 4.23% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Marathon Partners Equity Management Llc bought 30,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.48% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Mario Cibelli held 740,000 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $28.08 million, up from 710,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Marathon Partners Equity Management Llc who had been investing in Hd Supply Hldgs Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $7.48 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.25% or $0.1 during the last trading session, reaching $40.32. About 140,390 shares traded. HD Supply Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:HDS) has declined 2.18% since May 29, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 14.75% the S&P500.
Oak Ridge Investments Llc decreased its stake in Fidelity National Information (FIS) by 10.77% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Oak Ridge Investments Llc sold 8,226 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.54% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 68,118 shares of the miscellaneous company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $6.56 million, down from 76,344 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Oak Ridge Investments Llc who had been investing in Fidelity National Information for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $33.95B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.88% or $0.91 during the last trading session, reaching $102.55. About 108,738 shares traded. Fidelity National Information Services, Inc. (NYSE:FIS) has risen 21.20% since May 29, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 8.63% the S&P500.
